
FUNCTION 'QCM 8006 - Weekly DHU' GLOBAL
    IF (WebAutomation.IfWebPageContains.WebPageContainsElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... yDHUByLine\' 2']['Div \'/QCM8006 - Weekly DHU by Line\'']) THEN
        WebAutomation.GoToWebPage.GoToWebPage BrowserInstance: Browser Url: Data8006 WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
        WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... yDHUByLine\' 2']['Div \'Date Range *\''])
        @@RepairWithAIVision: 'True'
WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextFieldUsePhysicalKeyboard BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... yDHUByLine\' 2']['Input text \'drp_8006\' 2'] Text: $'''%FormattedDateTime% - %FormattedDateTime%''' Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
        ON ERROR REPEAT 10 TIMES WAIT 3
        END
        WebAutomation.ExecuteJavascript BrowserInstance: Browser Javascript: $'''function ExecuteScript() {
    return new Promise(function (resolve) {
        var targets = [
        \'[id*=\"chkbShowDefectList_8006\"]\',
        \'[id*=\"chkbShowSummaryFirst_8006\"]\'
        ];
        var results = [];
        var i = 0;

        function next() {
            if (i >= targets.length) { resolve(results.join(\" | \")); return; }
            var selector = targets[i];
            var attempts = 0, maxAttempts = 20, delayMs = 200; // ~4s ceiling

            (function poll() {
                var input = document.querySelector(selector);
                var wrapper = input && input.closest(\'.e-checkbox-wrapper\');
                var checkSpan = wrapper && wrapper.querySelector(\'span.e-frame\');

                if (checkSpan) {
                    if (!checkSpan.classList.contains(\'e-check\')) {
                        checkSpan.click();
                        results.push(selector + \": Clicked\");
                    } else {
                        results.push(selector + \": Already checked\");
                    }
                    i++; next();
                } else if (attempts++ < maxAttempts) {
                    setTimeout(poll, delayMs);
                } else {
                    results.push(selector + \": Not found after retries\");
                    i++; next();
                }
            })();
        }
        next();
    });
}'''
        ON ERROR REPEAT 5 TIMES WAIT 3
        END
        SET DHU_Weekly_Checkpoint TO ['END LINE QI', 'FIN TOP SIDE QC']
        LOOP FOREACH Current_DHU_Weekly_Checkpoint IN DHU_Weekly_Checkpoint
            WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... yDHUByLine\' 2']['Div \'END LINE QIQC Checkpoint *\''])
            WebAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextFieldUsePhysicalKeyboard BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... yDHUByLine\' 2']['Input text \'SEWING ENDLINE QC\''] Text: Current_DHU_Weekly_Checkpoint Mode: WebAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace UnfocusAfterPopulate: True WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
            ON ERROR REPEAT 10 TIMES WAIT 3
            END
            WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButtonPressDialogButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... pTopDefect\'']['Button \'VIEW\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 20 DialogButton: $'''OK'''
            ON ERROR REPEAT 5 TIMES WAIT 2
            ON ERROR PressButtonError
                GOTO 'End the subflow'
            END
            LABEL 'Re-try for QCM 8006'
            WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... pTopDefect\'']['Span \'viewer_toolbar_export\''])
            WAIT 5
            WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... pTopDefect\'']['Span \'viewer_toolbar_export\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
            ON ERROR REPEAT 5 TIMES WAIT 2
            ON ERROR PressButtonError
                GOTO 'End the subflow'
            END
            WAIT (WebAutomation.WaitForWebPageContent.WebPageToContainElement BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... yDHUByLine\' 2']['List item \'Excel Export\'']) FOR 5 
            ON ERROR TimeoutError
                GOTO 'Re-try for QCM 8006'
            END
            WebAutomation.PressButton.PressButton BrowserInstance: Browser Control: appmask['Web Page \'h ... yDHUByLine\' 2']['List item \'Excel Export\''] WaitForPageToLoadTimeout: 60
            ON ERROR REPEAT 5 TIMES WAIT 2
            ON ERROR PressButtonError
                GOTO 'End the subflow'
            END
            WAIT (UIAutomation.WaitForWindowContent.WindowToContainElement Element: appmask['Window \'QCM8006 - Weekly DHU by Line - Google Chrome\'']['Window \'Save As\'']) FOR 300 
            ON ERROR WaitForWindowContentError
                GOTO 'End the subflow'
            ON ERROR TimeoutError
                GOTO 'End the subflow'
            END
            UIAutomation.PopulateTextField.PopulateTextField TextField: appmask['Window \'QCM8006 - Weekly DHU by Line - Google Chrome\'']['Edit \'File name:\''] Text: $'''%Download_Path%\\%CurrentFactory%-%FormattedDateTimeForNaming%-DHU By Line Weekly for 8006 (%Current_DHU_Weekly_Checkpoint%).xlsx''' Mode: UIAutomation.PopulateTextMode.Replace ClickType: UIAutomation.PopulateMouseClickType.SingleClick
            UIAutomation.PressButton Button: appmask['Window \'QCM8006 - Weekly DHU by Line - Google Chrome\'']['Button \'Save\''] Simulate: False
            ON ERROR PressButtonError
                GOTO 'End the subflow'
            END
            WAIT (File.WaitForFile.Created File: $'''%Download_Path%\\%CurrentFactory%-%FormattedDateTimeForNaming%-DHU By Line Weekly for 8006 (%Current_DHU_Weekly_Checkpoint%).xlsx''') FOR 120 
            ON ERROR TimeoutError
                GOTO 'Re-try for QCM 8006'
            END
            LABEL 'End the subflow'
            IF (File.IfFile.DoesNotExist File: $'''%Download_Path%\\%CurrentFactory%-%FormattedDateTimeForNaming%-DHU By Line Weekly for 8006 (%Current_DHU_Weekly_Checkpoint%).xlsx''') THEN
                Variables.AddItemToList Item: $'''%CurrentFactory%-%FormattedDateTimeForNaming%-DHU By Line Weekly for 8006 (%Current_DHU_Weekly_Checkpoint%)''' List: Missing_Files
            END
        END
    END
END FUNCTION
